description: This PHP source file defines the HeadersMetadataStrategy class, which implements the MetadataStrategyInterface. It provides methods to save metadata from a MetadataEnvelope into S3 object request arguments and to load metadata headers into a MetadataEnvelope from S3 object responses, specifically for encrypted objects.

classes.name: HeadersMetadataStrategy
classes.description: Implements metadata handling strategies for S3 encryption, specifically for storing and retrieving metadata headers related to encrypted objects.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores metadata headers from a MetadataEnvelope into the arguments for a PutObject request.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Creates a MetadataEnvelope from metadata headers in the GetObject response.
